audit.why: 53.61% WR over 2634 games. Rough levels 1-3 (Mantra available at level 1, 950-range RQ poke), then Vex takes over from 4 onward because Karma has no dash or blink. Early is the hard part; mid/late favour Vex.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart was a blanket 'Skill' on all 7 rows while packet levelChart and content win[] agree: Karma rows 0-2, Vex rows 3-6. Whys were generic Vex boilerplate mentioning dashes Karma does not have.
audit.why: Karma starts with Mantra and out-ranges Vex early; from level 4 Vex's W+Q burst plus Karma's total lack of mobility flips the lane.
audit.corrected: Flipped all 7 sides to match win[] (already correct, so side edited alone), adjusted ratings, rewrote every why grounded in the actual kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Template text assumed a dashing enemy ('every trade he answers with a dash'); Karma has zero dashes, so Vex's passive dash-punish never triggers off Karma herself. Cooldowns field had no numbers. Misgendered throughout.
audit.why: Kit: Karma R Mantra 40/38/36/34s and her passive refunds it on damaging abilities; W Focused Resolve 12s, 675-range tether that roots if unbroken; E Inspire 10-8s shield; Q 950 range projectile. Vex R missile cannot be dodged by Karma without Flash since she has no blink.
audit.corrected: tradeGood/tradeBad, cooldowns, enemyWin and both bleed bullets rewritten around Mantra cycles, tether range and her lack of mobility.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing-interactions flags Karma's Mantra-W self-heal; report[8] itemization had no anti-heal line.
audit.why: RW heals her during the extended root — Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal line added to report[8].t within the length band.
